metadata.name: options_vault
metadata.description: Covered-call vault built on options_core + auction_venue (audit package 3)

accounts.name: vault_position
docs: The FIFO head entry; closed after redemption, rent to the cranker.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: The share coin: Sui's fresh `TreasuryCap<VShare>` becomes a mint
created here with the vault PDA as sole authority — zero supply by
construction.

accounts.name: round_state
docs: pps[round], set exactly once here.

accounts.name: prev_round_state
docs: pps[round − 1]; required for every round after genesis. Identity
pinned in the handler (vault + round fields) — an optional account
can't carry a sibling-referencing seeds constraint through the IDL
build.

accounts.name: core_treasury_token
docs: Fee destination: core treasury's underlying token account
(ownership verified in the handler).

accounts.name: vault_position
docs: The FIFO tail entry, created only when a winner exists.

accounts.name: winner_dest
docs: ownership.

types.name: Auction
docs: One escrowed ascending auction — the unification of `rfq.move`,
`rfq_put.move` and `swap_auction.move` (same machinery, different
legs). Escrowed bids are what make the best bid always settleable,
which is what makes the settle crank permissionless.

fields.name: bucket
docs: The options_core bucket for adapter modes; `Pubkey::default()` for
pure swaps.

fields.name: amount
docs: Escrowed amount (underlying for calls, cash collateral for puts,
sell-side tokens for swaps).

fields.name: notional
docs: Option notional in underlying units (== amount for calls; the put
notional for puts; 0 for swaps).

fields.name: reserve_bid
docs: Bids below this are rejected — the only price-safety floor a quiet
auction has.

fields.name: snipe_window_ms
docs: Anti-snipe: a best bid inside `snipe_window_ms` of the deadline
pushes it out by `snipe_extension_ms`, capped at `max_deadline_ms`.

fields.name: min_increment_bps
docs: Minimum improvement over the current best, in bps of the best.

fields.name: best_bidder
docs: The bid escrow token account's balance IS the best bid.

fields.name: best_token_recipient
docs: Where the winner wants the option coins (call/put recipient wallet)
or the swapped escrow (swap mode).

fields.name: position_recipient
docs: Owner of the minted Position (adapter modes).

fields.name: proceeds_token
docs: Exact token account receiving the winning bid (net premium for
adapters, the bid tokens for swaps). Fixed at creation so a
coupled venue (the vault) can absorb into its own vaults.

fields.name: refund_token
docs: Exact token account receiving the escrow back on the no-winner /
refund / expired paths.

fields.name: settle_authority
docs: When set, only this authority (a coupled venue's PDA, signing via
CPI) may settle — the analog of `rfq.move`'s `coupled` flag.

types.name: Bucket
docs: Covered-call bucket (Sui `Bucket<U, S, C>`). The generics become stored
mint pubkeys; the `TreasuryCap<Call>` becomes `call_mint` with this PDA
as sole mint/burn authority, so outstanding supply == outstanding
options exactly as on Sui. Bucket isolation is the runtime constraint
`token_account.mint == bucket.call_mint` (checked on every mint/burn
path) instead of a type-system guarantee — an explicit audit item.

fields.name: strike
docs: Real ratio (settlement smallest-units per underlying smallest-unit)
= `strike / 10^strike_scale`.

fields.name: invalidated
docs: Admin-controlled freeze on new writes; exercises and redeems are
unaffected.

fields.name: salt
docs: PDA-seed salt so an identical (pair, expiry, strike) bucket can be
re-created if one is invalidated (Sui allowed duplicates freely).

types.name: DepositReceipt
docs: Claim ticket for a queued deposit: claimable at `pps[round − 1]` once
that price exists.

types.name: RoundState
docs: pps[r], set exactly once when round r finalizes (the Move `Table`
entry). `claim_shares` / `complete_withdraw` pass the round they need.

types.name: Vault
docs: Port of `vault::Vault<U, S, VShare>`. Balances live in PDA-seeded token
accounts (an ATA can't hold three underlying sub-balances); the share
`TreasuryCap` becomes `share_mint` with this PDA as authority; the pps
`Table` becomes per-round `RoundState` PDAs; the positions
`ObjectTable` becomes `VaultPosition` index PDAs + head/tail.

fields.name: admin
docs: The Move AdminCap holder, for config/pause (rotule via creator).

fields.name: pending_config
docs: Stashed by `update_config`, applied at the next finalize so the
admin cannot change rules mid-round.

fields.name: current_expiry_ms
docs: Expiry of `current_bucket`; 0 when none.

fields.name: selling_ends_ms
docs: `open_rfq` forbidden after this.

fields.name: round_premium_collected
docs: Net-of-protocol-fee premium collected this round, settlement units.

fields.name: round_swap_settlement_out
docs: Cumulative swap legs this round, for the premium→underlying
conversion at the round's realized rate.

fields.name: auction_nonce
docs: Monotonic per-vault auction salt for CPI-created auctions.

types.name: VaultConfig
docs: Port of `vault::VaultConfig` — field-for-field.

types.name: VaultPosition
docs: FIFO index entry for a Position held by the vault (the Move
`ObjectTable<u64, Position>` row). Created at settle_rfq, closed at
crank_redeem.

types.name: WithdrawReceipt
docs: Two-step withdrawal ticket: pays `shares × pps[round] / PPS_SCALE`
once round `round` finalizes.
